title: Example images and retained response data for carbon-ceramic DME-GAN analysis
selection: The first 20 numerically ordered saved evaluation fields are included for each comparison model. The first 500 saved fields from the selected epoch-270 screening library are included for DME-GAN. All 302 retained response records are included.
response_processing: Only response columns consumed by the examples are exported from the retained solver tables; numerical values are preserved. The 300-row descriptor-response table is supplied with its original numeric values.

agent_inputs.description: Paired retained section fields and unchanged response targets for new agent-assisted runs
